rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits high melanin saturation (black/dark-grey pixels) covering approximately 75% of the surface area, specifically concentrated along the perimeter and philtrum, with a central depigmented region of pink/pale-tan pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: The central depigmented area of the rhinarium forms a distinct inverted triangular or 'V' shaped pattern.
